verdicts.claim: Every public string uses American spelling (Orb's rule of 2026-10-18), enforced by Tools' scan over public strings and ui/data/*.json; the scan reads ui/data only, so it misses code strings ('Licence' in ui_licences.gd) and lacks 'manoeuvre' and 'armour'.
verdicts.what_is_true: The scan (check-site-interim.mjs:57) runs only over site pages, ui/data/*.json and the words file (lines 331, 389, 454). So 'Licence:' and 'Licence texts' in ui_licences.gd:24,26 ship in the live pin 257a766c, MANOEUVRE (stances.json) and 'ARMOUR OPEN' (terms.json:34) pass because the regex lacks them, and README.md:7,9 carry 'Licence' and 'analyser'. This is Orb's house style, not release safety.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: A style rule sits in Legal's records (RL-162/192/193) and fails the interim site check, so a spelling slip can fail the same export that carries the real safety checks.
verdicts.fix: Move the rule to Orb's style guide and Localization. Make the scan a lint that does not block, or widen it to .gd strings, README, 'manoeuvre' and 'armour' as Tools' own check, outside Legal's records.
verdicts.belongs_to: Orb's creative direction (house style); Tools for the scan

verdicts.claim: Prototype bug KB-001: a signature against an ESCAPE defender hits less as the attacker's tier rises (a sign error), an accidental rubber band once fighters differ.
verdicts.what_is_true: Reproduced: known-bugs.test.js passes KB-001 (36.4% hit at a 3-tier lead, 65.8% trailing). Line 589 has the sign error, and the prototype is unchanged since 7233c96. The mean tier gap is 0.008, so no metric moves. The same formula is in the frozen JS oracle (beam.js:21). The GDScript game's beam outcome is data-driven (sim/director/data.gd:638); I did not check whether it has the same sign.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None as a QA register entry. In the safety inventory it is noise that dilutes real items.
verdicts.fix: Keep it in qa/known-bugs.md as a gameplay register and drop it from the safety inventory. Combat to check whether the data rule in the GDScript game has the same sign.

verdicts.claim: Prototype bug KB-002: the 1.35x damage against a charging defender never applies.
verdicts.what_is_true: Reproduced: the test passes. A light hit does 36.4 (26 x 1.4) and a signature 230, neither with x1.35, because line 411 sets the defender 'locked' before hit() reads 'charging' at line 326. The effects file kb2 shows 118 hits on charging defenders, 0 read as charging, and 0.5% of damage. This is a balance bug in the legacy prototype.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Noise in the safety inventory. No gate depends on it.
verdicts.fix: Keep it in QA's prototype register and drop it from the safety inventory.

verdicts.claim: Prototype bug KB-003: a parried exchange still gives the attacker a chain window, so 13% of counted chains are phantom.
verdicts.what_is_true: Reproduced: after a parry (seed 1) the test sees '2 HIT CHAIN', -6 ki, 0 damage. openWindow (544-546) never checks ex.cancel and dirUpdate (572-574) then chains. The effects file kb3 shows 499 of 3,817 chain events phantom (13.1%), 3.817 reported against 3.318 real. This distorts a legacy baseline metric.
verdicts.fix: Keep it in QA's prototype register and drop it from the safety inventory.

verdicts.claim: Prototype bug KB-004: every chain strike ignores the defender's stance, putting 76.5 HP a match through a guard.
verdicts.what_is_true: Reproduced: the guarded hits do 9.88 each, then the chain strike does 73.92 (seed 1). Line 554 passes ignoreStance:true. The effects file kb4 shows guardedExtraDamagePerMatch 76.54 and chain strikes at 18.5% of all damage. This is a balance bug in the legacy prototype.
verdicts.fix: Keep it in QA's prototype register and drop it from the safety inventory.

verdicts.claim: Prototype bug KB-005: a dodged signature freezes the defender 300 units up for 0.87 s.
verdicts.what_is_true: Reproduced (seed 4): the defender jumps +300 in one step at 0.82 s, then stays still for 52 steps (0.87 s). Line 616 sets D.y += 300 with zero velocity. The effects file kb5 shows 0.40 s a match. This is a feel issue, and whether it is a bug or the design is Combat's call.
verdicts.fix: Keep it in QA's prototype register for Combat's call and drop it from the safety inventory.

verdicts.claim: Prototype bug KB-006: the rush flies through terrain (15% of rushes) and through standing buildings (6.7%).
verdicts.what_is_true: Reproduced: in the mountains 25 of 36 rush steps are inside the ground (up to 547 units), and in the city 25 of 38 steps are inside towers. stepRush clamps only the last frame (748, 751). The effects file kb6 shows 14.8% and 6.7%. The test asserts all six bugs are present (8 passed). This is a collision and look issue in the legacy prototype.
verdicts.fix: Keep it in QA's prototype register and drop it from the safety inventory.

verdicts.claim: GB-002: the high-tier sky reaction read as a glowing patch, and the clouds shimmered as fighters moved. It was turned off by default in 632f6c9, and the shimmer above 4,800 units was fixed.
verdicts.what_is_true: 632f6c9 makes sky_react_on false by default and reads the cloud pattern at the plain height (sky.gdshader cp line). Both are in the live pin 257a766c and at HEAD. The 4,800-unit figure comes from the commit's own README text. /play/?skyreact=1 can still turn the reaction on (URL_ARGS at the pin). Nobody has re-verified it in play, and I did not run Godot. A slow cloud crawl is a look fault, not a flash event.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Small. Carrying a look fix in safety records invites a flash re-check it does not need.
verdicts.fix: Retire it from the safety records and keep it in Rendering's and QA's register. QA re-verifies it on a web capture when convenient.

verdicts.claim: GB-004 to GB-007, playtest observations: a ranged press locks both fighters (a design question), mountain tumbles gain too much momentum, launched fighters flew feet first (fixed cce8a59), and levitating rocks ride along with a fast fighter.
verdicts.what_is_true: cce8a59 exists: head-first launch flight plus lead_scan.gd. GB-007 is already fixed in code by 0c1d39f7: rocks.gd:144-156 lets the pieces go in world space when the fighter speeds up, so the register's 'open' is stale. I did not check GB-004 or GB-005 in code. All four are feel or look matters.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: A stale 'open' on GB-007 can send VFX to re-fix something already fixed. None of the four bears on release safety.
verdicts.fix: Retire them from the safety records. QA marks GB-007 fixed in 0c1d39f7 and re-verifies it. GB-004 goes to Game Design and GB-005 to World.
verdicts.belongs_to: QA & Balance (register); Game Design, World, Animation, VFX

verdicts.claim: GB-009: a brink fighter could not be finished by bolts alone. The finish was fixed in df05b9f, but the blaster's win rate (82 to 88% against scripts) is open balance.
verdicts.what_is_true: df05b9f exists ('the barrage counts every clean shot of any kind, window 120 (GB-009)'), and timing-edge.js has the E4 and E5 rows with a 95% finish bar. The 82.5 to 87.5% win rates are QA's reported numbers. I did not re-run them, because that needs Godot. This is a balance question.
verdicts.fix: Keep it as an open balance item for Game Design, outside the safety records.

verdicts.claim: A drifting brawl must never pass through a building face or damage a building (hard row C5).
verdicts.what_is_true: C5 is a planned hard row, and plan:97 says it is not built. WorldStructures.blockedAt exists (structures.gd:143). Nothing shows whether brawls clip buildings today. It is a collision and feel rule, not release safety.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Noise in the safety inventory, and an unbuilt gate that could read as a release blocker.
verdicts.fix: Keep C5 as a QA gameplay gate and build the nudging script with Encounter. Drop it from the safety inventory.

verdicts.claim: A setting may change only what is drawn, never what the sim computes, so players on different settings can still play each other and replays stay valid.
verdicts.what_is_true: ADR 0012 item 3 and ADR 0013 item 4 state the rule. No sim .gd file outside tools reads reduced_motion, reduce_flashing or quality (grep empty), and the swing reduction exists only in render (split_rig.gd:1071). swing-motion.md:29 only recommends a sim flag agreed in the lobby and carried in the match header, which keeps the sim shared, and it is not built. I did not trace every settings path.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Small. The 'contradiction' note could prompt rework of an unbuilt proposal that already keeps the sim shared.
verdicts.fix: Retire it from the safety records as a Simulation and Netcode architecture rule. If the swing flag is ever built, record it in an ADR as a match-header flag rather than a per-player setting.

verdicts.claim: A human player can switch stance while locked in an exchange and take only 0.38x damage.
verdicts.what_is_true: Fixed in the GDScript game. Since 7fdfbe75 (2026-09-29) damage.gd:70-73 uses the stances frozen at requestAttack (exchange.gd:159, 340, 853), and the live pin has the same code. Only the frozen JS oracle (damage.js:16) and the prototype still read the live stance. The 'status unknown' handoff line is stale, and the matter is balance, not safety.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: An open 'needs a ruling' item for Game Design and Controls on something already fixed in the game.
verdicts.fix: Correct sim/README.md row 3 and docs/ep/handoff.md:40 to say the GDScript stance freeze (7fdfbe75) fixed it and the JS oracle keeps it, then retire the item.

verdicts.claim: GB-008: a launch or charge cleared a lock-broken fighter's flag without the found event or the 6 s guard.
verdicts.what_is_true: fd381c6 replaces both direct clears with SimHiding.regainLock (now fighter.gd:730 and launch.gd:926). The remaining direct clear at exchange.gd:313 is for cover-hiding (canHide) fighters, and the lock-break branch next to it calls regainLock. I did not re-run QA's confirmation on df05b9f. It was an event-stream bug, now fixed.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Noise only. The record is accurate and closed.
verdicts.fix: Keep it as a closed entry in QA's register and drop it from the safety inventory.

verdicts.claim: The harness refuses a win share for a scripted player that pressed fewer than 100 times a match (SCRIPT BLIND), so a blind script cannot report a quiet 0 of 40.
verdicts.what_is_true: timing-edge.js:130-131 replaces only the Verdict cell with 'SCRIPT BLIND (not a reading)'. The same row still prints the win share and interval (line 132), and the JSON keeps aWins. So the share is labeled, not refused. This is a QA harness matter for private test runs.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Small. A reader could take a printed 0 of 40 at face value if they miss the verdict cell.
verdicts.fix: QA either blanks the win-share cell for blind rows or rewords the plan to 'marks the row not a reading'. Keep it out of the safety records.

verdicts.claim: Six baselines printed launches 'by him' and 'on him' the wrong way round (the launch actor is the body sent), so their first-launch times are void.
verdicts.what_is_true: SimFx.launch(S, f, by) sets actor to the body sent (fx.gd:702-704). players.gd:1076-1088 now reads the actor as sent and the target as launcher, with a comment dating the error to 2026-10-17. The rerun file exists. I did not open the correction blocks in the older documents. This is QA data hygiene.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Noise only. It is corrected and private.
verdicts.fix: Keep it in QA's README changelog and drop it from the safety inventory.

batch_notes: No claim in AC-279 to AC-294 is a release-safety matter. Fifteen are MISFILED and one (AC-291) is OVERSTATED because the GDScript game already fixed it.
All six prototype bugs were reproduced with node qa/tests/known-bugs.test.js (8 passed, exit 0; TEMP pointed at the scratchpad). prototype/index.html has not changed since 7233c96.

Gap outside this slice: README.md:7 (public repo) says the hosted build is offline, but /play/ serves a playable build. README.md:9 says 'We are fixing them', which Legal's page-fixed-lines.md calls untrue since flash work paused. No check scans README.
The British-spelling scan is a failing check inside tools/check-site-interim.mjs, so a style slip can fail the export that also carries the flash and notice checks.
Stale records: GB-007 is fixed in 0c1d39f7 but listed open, and sim/README.md bug 3 is fixed in the GDScript sim (7fdfbe75) but listed as needing a ruling.
Not checked: whether the GDScript beam outcome data (sim/director/data.gd:638) has the KB-001 sign error, whether GDScript keeps KB-002's dead 1.35x path, and GB-004/GB-005 in code.
